## Où j'en suis
Dashboards v2 (drag and resize, layout saved per user) is merged in PR #418. Keyboard move/resize and the focus ring are in follow-up PR #423, open and waiting for Priya's review. The `dashboards_v2` flag is on for Zest on staging only; production stays off until the morning of the 24th. (source: ses-db-3, c3-06, ses-db-4, d4-05, d4-07)

- [en-cours] Keyboard move/resize and focus ring, in PR #423 (commit 8f1a2c7) (source: d4-05, 8f1a2c7)
- [prochaine-étape] Priya's review of PR #423 (source: d4-05)
- [prochaine-étape] Turn `dashboards_v2` on for Zest in production the morning of the 24th; Priya rehearses the demo on staging (source: d4-06, d4-07, b2-04)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit's KeyboardSensor applied every move twice and broke mouse drag, so it was removed (source: d4-02, d4-04)
- [essai-raté] CSS container queries are ignored on Zest's iPads (iOS 15, Safari below 16) (source: b2-01)
- [question] Deleting the legacy v1 dashboards: the date of January 5 appears only in an agent note and has not been confirmed by the team (source: b2-04, src-note-v1)
- [décision] Keep recharts and drop visx; PR #401 is closed (source: c3-03)
- [décision] ResizeObserver instead of container queries (source: b2-02)
- [décision] Own keyboard handler on the layout state, no dnd-kit (source: d4-04)
- [décision] Legacy v1 dashboards stay behind the flag until January (source: b2-04)
